positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Guest Credit & Angular 18 Migration Environment: Angular 18, Polymer.js (legacy), Node.js
Led the migration of a legacy Polymer.js guest-facing application to a modern Angular 18 single-page application
Application allows guests to apply online for Visa Instant Credit and, upon approval, apply that credit toward Disneyland Resort (DLR) and Walt Disney World (WDW) tickets and resort stays in their cart
Built the Node.js backend serving the SPA, handling guest login/security, and acting as a gateway to multiple microservices — consolidating and reformatting their responses before returning them to the front-end UI
[Note: add a quantifiable metric if available — e.g., guest transaction volume, credit approval throughput]
Theme Park Availability Microservice Environment: Java, Spring Boot, Redis, AWS, Docker, Splunk
Built a Java/Spring Boot microservice providing theme park availability based on the calendar dates a guest selects
Used Redis for caching, deployed to AWS with Docker containerization, and used Splunk for logging/observability
[Note: add a quantifiable metric if available — e.g., cache hit rate, response time, requests/day]
Ticket Purchase & Reservation Management (Current) Environment: Node.js, AWS Lambda, S3, CloudWatch

Maintaining a Node.js guest-facing web application for purchasing WDW/DLR theme park tickets and managing theme park reservations (create, modify, cancel, and edit party details for a selected visit date); the app communicates with backend AWS Lambda functions that I maintain and enhance
Validate deployments to AWS (Lambda, S3) and use CloudWatch logs to debug and investigate application exceptions and alarms
Use Cursor and Claude Code to build AI-assisted development workflows — authoring prompts and running plan-and-execute cycles to accelerate feature development and maintenance

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
Environment: Angular 9/RxJS, Java 1.8, Spring Boot, Kafka, MS-SQL, Jenkins, AWS, JUnit, Jasmine, SonarQube, Robot Framework, Liquibase, Docker, Kubernetes, Jira
Built a full-stack web application with an Angular 9 front end and Spring Boot back end, serving as the front-end user portal and routing layer for the SeCT-IMS platform
Designed and implemented Spring Boot microservices for the JP9711 project, supporting after-action reviews and simulated military exercise lifecycle management, event planning, and booking within SeCT-IMS
Built asynchronous messaging between microservices using Kafka, triggering long-running workflows with guaranteed message delivery
Implemented front-end and back-end microservices for booking and scheduling simulated exercise activities, including resource-conflict management
Implemented front-end and back-end microservices for planning and managing exercise-related content, collecting and storing large, complex datasets
Documented system requirements; conducted front-end and back-end unit tests; participated in peer code reviews

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
[Note: dates inferred to close the gap between SSCS and Lockheed Martin — please confirm]
Environment: ReactJS, Node.js, Express.js, Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Oracle, Liquibase

Built and maintained Spring Boot web services powering Florida Blue's Customer Experience Workflow applications for claims processing
Built and maintained Spring Boot batch processes that updated claim request statuses
Implemented a Node.js proxy application that consolidated multiple web service calls and formatted/grouped JSON responses for the front end
Built React front-end applications for displaying claims status and submitting/updating claim requests
Owned system documentation, unit testing, peer code review, and evaluation/performance testing of purchased products
Implemented IT controls to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of application data

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
Architect, design and develop full stack web application for use within the Apple's iCloud deployment solution using MEAN stack ecosystem.

Design and coded back end RESTful API using Node.j and Express.js for integrating existing Apple Web service API

Design MongoDB schema, collections and queries (Mongoose)

Implement web user interface with Angular 1.5 and Angular-UI framework

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Full stack application developer responsible for back-end and front-end implementation of DoD line of business application. 

Designed and implemented Spring based REST API that handles the user’s authorization and handling database queries from Oracle database. 

Implements front end solution using JSF, ADF and JQuery.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed plans and implemented middle ware applications for Disney Cruise, Walt Disney World and Disney Vacation Club for online vacation reservations.  

Environment: Spring, J2EE, EJB, JMS/MDB, IBM MQ, Java 1.6, Apache Axis 2 (1.4.x) web service, JavaScript, CSS, Servlets,  JAXP, JAXB, JBoss AOP(ver. 2.0.x), Spring 2.5, Tomcat 6, Hibernate (3.2.x) ,Spring 2.x AOP, Quartz, JBoss
